# 编辑器生成的程序 + 期望坐标（播放端逐点比对用）
# 由 particle-editor 的 test/editor-fixture.test.js 生成；改参数后要重新生成。
# 坐标是**最短往返表示**（JS String(number)）——写 toFixed(6) 会让播放端的全精度值显出假偏差。
-----SOURCE-----
// 由编辑器编译生成：改物体参数后请重新导出，不要手改
// o1 fx-surface｜图元 box｜程序化表面采样 density=4｜384 点
// 数据表的大小只与几何有关（与点数无关）；每个点由 hash 现算，不烘坐标
const st_p = [
  -64,-64,64,64,-64,64,-64,64,64,64,64,64,64,-64,-64,-64,-64,-64,64,64,-64,-64,64,-64,
  -64,-64,-64,-64,-64,64,-64,64,-64,-64,64,64,64,-64,64,64,-64,-64,64,64,64,64,64,-64,
  -64,64,64,64,64,64,-64,64,-64,64,64,-64,-64,-64,-64,64,-64,-64,-64,-64,64,64,-64,64
]
const st_tri = [
  0,1,3,0,3,2,4,5,7,4,7,6,8,9,11,8,11,10,12,13,15,12,15,14,
  16,17,19,16,19,18,20,21,23,20,23,22
]
const st_cumN = [
  0,32,64,96,128,160,192,224,256,288,320,352,384
]
const st_ncols = [
  6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6
]
const st_nrows = [
  6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6,6
]

func setup() {
  let i = 0
  while (i < 384) {
    let p = this.spawn({
      color: [1, 1, 1, 1],
      scale: 1,
      glow: false,
      light: 0,
      life: -1
    })
    let st_t = 0
    while (st_t < 11 && st_cumN[st_t + 1] <= i) { st_t = st_t + 1 }
    let st_k = i - st_cumN[st_t]
    let st_cc = st_ncols[st_t]
    let st_rr = st_nrows[st_t]
    if (st_cc < 1) { st_cc = 1 }
    if (st_rr < 1) { st_rr = 1 }
    let st_u = ((st_k % st_cc) + 0.5) / st_cc
    let st_v = (floor(st_k / st_cc) + 0.5) / st_rr
    if (st_u + st_v > 1) { st_u = 1 - st_u; st_v = 1 - st_v }
    let st_cw = 1 - st_u - st_v
    let st_i0 = st_tri[st_t * 3]
    let st_i1 = st_tri[st_t * 3 + 1]
    let st_i2 = st_tri[st_t * 3 + 2]
    let st_x = (st_p[st_i0 * 3] * st_cw + st_p[st_i1 * 3] * st_u + st_p[st_i2 * 3] * st_v) / 64
    let st_y = (st_p[st_i0 * 3 + 1] * st_cw + st_p[st_i1 * 3 + 1] * st_u + st_p[st_i2 * 3 + 1] * st_v) / 64
    let st_z = (st_p[st_i0 * 3 + 2] * st_cw + st_p[st_i1 * 3 + 2] * st_u + st_p[st_i2 * 3 + 2] * st_v) / 64
    p.position = [st_x, st_y, st_z]
    i = i + 1
  }
}
